channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show setlist: Every song
item.description: Bad Bunny headlined the Super Bowl LX halftime show on Sunday. Here are all the songs he played on his setlist.

item.title: Bad Bunny didn't mention ICE at the Super Bowl. A different message was front and center.
item.description: The singer listed the names of all countries in North and South America, and said, "God Bless America."

item.title: Some Kalshi transfers are delayed during the Super Bowl
item.description: Kalshi said it saw over $325 million in volume less than an hour before the championship game started.

item.title: Trump's review of Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show is in and it's safe to say he didn't like it
item.description: President Donald Trump called Bad Bunny's halftime show "absolutely terrible."

item.title: Elon Musk said we'd reach Mars in 2026. Now, he says SpaceX is building a city on the moon.
item.description: The CEO said that the company is shifting its focus from Mars to creating a "self-growing city" on the moon because it would be more practical.

item.title: Fashion moments and status symbols you might have missed at the Super Bowl LX
item.description: Travis Scott arrived at the Super Bowl in vintage Chanel, and Travis Kelce looked sharp in a black double-breasted Fear of God blazer.

item.title: K-pop It Boy Joshua Hong continued his US charm offensive at the Super Bowl
item.description: Hong, an American-born member of the K-pop boyband Seventeen, was seen on the field in a preppy outfit, soaking up the game day vibes.

item.title: Check out the big names in business who showed up for the Super Bowl
item.description: Apple CEO Tim Cook, Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong, and Kim Kardashian were some of the big names present at the Sunday game.

item.title: Trump said Bad Bunny's Super Bowl performance made 'no sense,' but his iconography spoke volumes
item.description: Bad Bunny celebrated Puerto Rico at the 2026 Super Bowl, where he became the first Spanish-speaking solo artist to headline the halftime show. Trump hated it.

item.title: I flew across the country to be a bunch of dancing grass at Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Andrew Athias said his job at the halftime show was really easy: "Don't move. Stand here and be one with the grass."
